custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the hand-can interface — AI often fails at realistic grip mechanics and pressure deformation. Also scrutinize the nozzle: real actuators have precise mechanical details (ridges, slots, spring housing); AI tends to oversimplify or melt these. Background reflections in mirror should align with foreground pose — any mismatch indicates depth/placement failure. Do not over-penalize motion blur if it's consistent with camera shake, but flag if blur patterns are unnatural (e.g., directional smear without corresponding motion vector).
